Name: PowerShell Script Block Logging enabled
Description: Script Block Logging records the full content of every PowerShell script block executed, including obfuscated/encoded commands. Essential for detecting LOLBin abuse, encoded payloads, and in-memory attacks.
Rationale: Script Block Logging records the full content of every PowerShell script block executed, including obfuscated commands.
Remediation: GPO: Windows Components > Windows PowerShell > Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging = Enabled. Events: Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational (4104).

Name: PowerShell Module Logging enabled
Description: Module Logging captures the pipeline execution details of every PowerShell module, revealing exactly which commands and parameters were used.
Rationale: Module Logging captures pipeline execution details, revealing which commands and parameters were used.
Remediation: GPO: Windows Components > Windows PowerShell > Turn on Module Logging = Enabled, ModuleNames = *.

Name: PowerShell Transcription logging enabled
Description: Transcription writes a full record of each PowerShell session input/output to disk, creating a persistent audit trail even if event logs are cleared.
Rationale: Transcription writes a full session record to disk, surviving event-log clearing.
Remediation: GPO: Windows Components > Windows PowerShell > Turn on PowerShell Transcription = Enabled. Set OutputDirectory to a protected share.

Name: PowerShell Script Block invocation logging enabled
Description: EnableScriptBlockInvocationLogging=1 also logs script blocks at invocation time, not just definition time, capturing more attack activity.
Rationale: Invocation logging captures script blocks at run time, not just when defined.
Remediation: Registry: set EnableScriptBlockInvocationLogging = 1. Must accompany EnableScriptBlockLogging = 1.

Name: Process creation command line captured in event logs
Description: Without this, Event ID 4688 logs only the executable name, not the arguments. Command-line capture reveals LOLBin abuse, encoded commands, and lateral movement.
Rationale: Command-line capture in 4688 reveals LOLBin abuse and encoded commands.
Remediation: GPO: System > Audit Process Creation > Include command line in process creation events = Enabled. Requires Advanced Audit Policy 'Audit Process Creation' = Success.
